d.d: A person who is exceptionally clever, gifted or skilled in a particular area.
A wizard (an administrator of a multi-user dungeon).
To be promoted to wizard (administrator) status in a multi-user dungeon, by completing the game quest.
d.x: I lost interest and stopped playing soon after I wizzed.

d.d: Someone, usually male, who uses (or has skill with) magic, mystic items, and magical and mystical practices.
d.x: The wizard conjured up a large fireball.

d.d: One who is especially skilled or unusually talented in a particular field.
d.x: He was a financial wizard, capable of predicting the movements of the stock markets.

d.d: A computer program or script used to simplify complex operations, often for an inexperienced user.
d.x: Use the "Add Network Connection" wizard to connect to a network in a series of simple steps.
